name: A Falconstrike button is saved as Quick Shot (#5469)
contract: With the Falconstrike talent 573060 and its ready buff 573338, SyncFalconstrike (AscensionRangerFalconstrike.cpp:29, run on every player update) learns the highest Falconstrike rank the level allows (806443 at level 80, SpellLevel 60) as a temporary spell (learnSpell(replacement, true), line 42) and replaces every known Quick Shot rank (500074, 572727-572732) with it through SetTemporarySpellReplacement (line 47). A temporary spell is never written to character_spell, and Player::_LoadActions runs before the next sync, so a saved Falconstrike button would be refused and deleted at login. persisted_action_button reads Player::GetSavedActionButtonSpell, the spell id _SaveActions writes: a button holding Falconstrike must be saved as Quick Shot 500074, and a button holding Quick Shot itself is saved unchanged.

steps.label: The ready buff replaces Quick Shot with Falconstrike
The Falconstrike button is saved as Quick Shot
Control: an ordinary known spell is saved unchanged
